caseName: Delta Marine Contractors, Inc. v. Avondale Shipyards, Inc.
caseNameFull: Delta Marine Contractors, Inc. v. Avondale Shipyards, Inc.

opinions.text: Appeal from Ct. App. La., 4th Cir., dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari denied.
